name: SegmentedControl
title: SegmentedControl
summary: A pill-shaped two-option toggle, like One-time / Monthly on Give Online, where the chosen half fills charcoal (white on dark).
whenToUse: Switching between two or three equal, mutually exclusive modes that change what is shown below: gift frequency, Listen / Read, Radio / Podcasts.
whenNotToUse: Not for settings that apply on their own: use Switch.
Not for 4+ options or options that need explanation: use Radio or Select.
Not for navigation between pages: use tabs or links.

props.name: options
props.description: The two (at most three) segments, in display order.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value (controlled). Exactly one segment is always pressed.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected value (uncontrolled). Defaults to the first option.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value when a different segment is chosen. Never submits a form.

props.name: 'aria-label'
props.description: Accessible name of the group, for example "Gift frequency". Required unless `aria-labelledby` is set.

props.name: dark
props.description: Use on dark sections (`.on-dark`, `.sec-ink`, black): translucent track, white selected segment.

props.name: options
props.description: Two (or at most three) equal options.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value. Exactly one segment is always selected: pre-select the default.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the chosen value. Updates content at once; never submits a form.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the group, e.g. "Gift frequency".

props.name: dark
props.description: Use on black or ink surfaces: translucent track, white selected segment.

variantNotes: Light: selected segment `--charcoal-900` fill, white text; unselected `--charcoal-900` text on the track.
Dark (`.fm-seg-dark`, inside `.on-dark` / `.sec-ink` or on `--black`): track `rgba(255,255,255,.1)`; selected segment white with black text; unselected white text.
Hover: base `.chip` border darkens on the unselected segment.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Exactly one segment is pressed at all times; pre-select the default (Monthly on Give Online).
Selection is charcoal, not Horizon Blue: the blue primary belongs to the Give button below it.
Keep labels to one or two words, same length where possible.
Use two segments; three at most. Equal widths always.
Changing the segment updates content right away; it never submits a form.
Do not add icons or counts inside segments.
